content.title: It's National Burrito Day! Here's How to Get One For Free
content.text: We never need an excuse to chow down on a mouthwatering burrito, but there's one day a year where we make sure to celebrate the tasty entrée: National Burrito Day.This year, the hand-held holiday falls on Thursday, April 2, and burrito fans will be delighted to hear that they can take advantage of plenty of freebies and deals. Below, we've rounded up some of the most tempting offers that will satiate any burrito cravings you might have.Baja FreshBaja Fresh is selling $5 Baja Burritos with chicken on April 2. The single-use offer is available in stores at participating locations. Additionally, rewards members who make any purchase on National Burrito Day will get a coupon for $5 off a purchase of $20+ loaded into their account.Barberitos During the month of April, Barberitos customers can build and name their own burrito then share it on social. By doing so, they'll be entered for the chance to win free burritos for a year. Bubbakoo’s BurritosBubbakoo’s Burritos customers can take advantage of a buy one entrée, get one free burrito offer on the holiday. While ordering online or in the chain's app, use the code BURRITODAY at checkout or mention the promotion in stores.California TortillaOn April 2, California Tortilla customers who buy any burrito will get a $10 reward to use on a future purchase. Chef MeritoChef Merito is offering TODAY.com readers 25% off the following items on National Burrito Day with the code TODAYCHEF: three 25-ounce marinades and two 14-ounce seasonings.ChipotleChipotle is running its Burrito Vault game through April 1, allowing rewards members the opportunity to score prizes, including free burritos for a year and buy one, get one free entrée entrées. Chipotle rewards members can also get free delivery on April 2 when they order on the chain’s website or app with the code DELIVER. Chronic TacosChronic Tacos loyalty members who order in the chain's app on April 2 will be able to take advantage of a buy one, get one free burrito offer. Condado TacosCondado Tacos is offering half off all burritos on the holiday, no code required. The offer is valid for dine-in customers and those who order via the chain's app or website. It's not valid on third-party delivery.Del TacoDel Taco rewards members can get a free classic burrito with any $3 purchase at participating locations on the holiday. The single-use offer is available in the chain's app and website.Dog HausDog Haus rewards members can order a $3 Haus Burrito at participating locations and the proceeds will be donated to No Kid Hungry. Additionally, anyone who orders the $3 burrito on April 2 will score a buy one, get one free reward for Dog Haus’ Bad-Ass Breakfast Burritos.El Pollo LocoEl Pollo Loco is running a buy one, get one free burrito deal on April 2. Hot Head BurritosHot Head Burritos rewards members can take advantage of a buy one, get one free burrito offer online on April 2.Huddle HouseHuddle House rewards members can redeem a buy one, get one 50% off deal on MVP Burrito Meals.Laredo Taco CompanyLaredo Taco Company customers can order a $5 Chicken Fajita Burrito for a limited time at participating 7-Eleven, Speedway and Stripes locations.Margaritas Mexican Restaurant Margaritas Mexican Restaurant rewards members can save 50% off any burrito on April 2. Moe’s Southwest GrillMoe’s Southwest Grill will have a buy one, get one free offer on burritos, bowls and More Value Meals on April 2. PancherosPancheros is giving away 10,000 free burritos on the holiday. The chain will share four different codes on their social media accounts (Instagram, Facebook, X and TikTok) on April 2. Loyalty app users can then enter the code in the app to redeem their burrito.QDOBA In honor of National Burrito Day, QDOBA rewards members will receive a reward for a free burrito or bowl with the purchase of any entrée (excluding quesadillas) and drink. The offer is valid in restaurants and in the chain's app/website. Gold status rewards members will be able to redeem the offer through April 5.SurcherosSurcheros rewards members can take advantage of a buy one burrito, get one 50% off deal on April 2 in restaurants or in the chain's app or website.Taco Cabana Taco Cabana loyalty members can save 25% off their order with the purchase of a burrito.Taco John’sTaco John’s rewards members can get a free bean burrito any any purchase of $3+ on April 2 when they order in the chain's app.Tijuana FlatsOn April 2, Tijuana Flats customers can add sauce to their burrito for free with the code SAUCED26.TocayaTocaya rewards members can get a free side of chips and guacamole with the purchase of any burrito on the holiday.Torchy’s TacosTorchy’s Tacos will sell its breakfast burrito for $5 (in-restaurant only until 2 p.m.) on April 2.
